Run Tangent PCA on cell or nucleus boundary contours

Source: R/tpca_bridge.R
run_tpca.Rd

Calls compute_pre_shape_embedding() and run_kendall_tpca() from kendall_tpca.py via reticulate, then reads the results back into R.

run_tpca(
  boundary_parquet_path,
  output_dir = NULL,
  cell_ids = NULL,
  contour_type = c("cell", "nucleus"),
  num_vertices = 50L,
  cell_id_col = "cell_id",
  x_col = "vertex_x",
  y_col = "vertex_y",
  eta = 1,
  use_parallel = FALSE,
  num_threads = 8L,
  frechet_mean_tol = 1e-04,
  max_frechet_iter = 1000L,
  return_results = TRUE,
  load_pre_shape = TRUE,
  store_history = FALSE
)

Arguments

boundary_parquet_path

Path to a parquet file containing boundary coordinates.

output_dir

Directory for intermediate/output files. If NULL (default), a temporary directory is used and cleaned up when return_results = TRUE. An explicit path is created if absent and always left on disk.

cell_ids

Optional character vector of cell IDs to analyse.

contour_type

One of "cell" or "nucleus".

num_vertices

Integer. Vertices to resample each contour to. Default 50L.

cell_id_col

Column name for cell IDs. Default "cell_id".

x_col

Column name for x coordinates. Default "vertex_x".

y_col

Column name for y coordinates. Default "vertex_y".

eta

Learning rate for Fréchet mean iteration. Default 1.

use_parallel

Logical. Use multiprocessing in Python. Default FALSE.

num_threads

Integer. Parallel threads when use_parallel = TRUE. Default 8L.

frechet_mean_tol

Convergence tolerance. Default 1e-4.

max_frechet_iter

Maximum iterations. Default 1000L.

return_results

Logical. If TRUE (default), results are loaded into R and returned. If FALSE, results are written to disk and only the output paths are returned.

load_pre_shape

Logical. Whether to load the pre-shape embedding into Info$pre_shape_embedding. Default TRUE.

store_history

Logical. If TRUE, the Fréchet mean iteration history is attached to the returned list as attr(result, "frechet_history"), a named list with elements $grad_norm (numeric vector of per-iteration gradient norms) and $mu_history (array of mean shapes at each iteration). Only meaningful when return_results = TRUE. Default FALSE.

Value

When return_results = TRUE: a flat list with TPCA_Embedding, Info, Metadata, contour_type, and output_dir.

When return_results = FALSE: a list with output_path (character scalar, path to the directory containing output files).

Details

Operates on a single set of cells. For multi-group workflows, call this function once per group in an external loop.

See also

load_kstitch_results, store_tpca_results
